title: Fractions
prompt:
Write four fraction utility functions in `solution.py`:

**Requirements:**
1. `add_fractions(a, b)` -- adds two fraction tuples `(num, den)` and returns the simplified result as `(num, den)`
2. `simplify(num, den)` -- returns the simplified fraction as a tuple `(num, den)`
3. `to_mixed(num, den)` -- converts an improper fraction to mixed number form `(whole, numerator, denominator)`
4. `harmonic_sum(n)` -- returns the sum `1/1 + 1/2 + ... + 1/n` as a `Fraction` object

**Examples:**
```python
add_fractions((1, 2), (1, 3))  # (5, 6)
simplify(4, 8)                 # (1, 2)
to_mixed(7, 3)                 # (2, 1, 3)
harmonic_sum(1)                # Fraction(1, 1)
harmonic_sum(4)                # Fraction(25, 12)
```
hints: Fraction(num, den) creates an exact rational number
